summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude from gross income payments received from state-based catastrophe loss mitigation programs that are used to make improvements to property to reduce damage from windstorms, earthquakes, or wildfires.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude certain payments from gross income, effectively lowering the tax burden for individuals receiving these payments. This is the primary purpose of the bill.

The bill creates a new exclusion from gross income for payments received under state catastrophe loss mitigation programs, directly reducing federal tax revenue. This revenue loss would increase the deficit, though the legislation's primary focus is disaster mitigation tax parity rather than fiscal balance.
